options.name: ca_cert
options.description: The path to a Certificate Authority (CA) certificate. This option, if used, must specify the same certificate as used by the server.

options.name: channel
options.description: Name of replication channel. Multi-source replication is supported from MySQL 5.7. Mutually exclusive with I(connection_name). For more information see U(https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/replication-multi-source.html).

options.name: check_hostname
options.description: Whether to validate the server host name when an SSL connection is required. Corresponds to MySQL CLIs C(--ssl) switch. Setting this to C(false) disables hostname verification. Use with caution. Requires pymysql >= 0.7.11.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: The path to a client public key certificate.

options.name: client_key
options.description: The path to the client private key.

options.name: config_file
options.description: Specify a config file from which user and password are to be read. The default config file, C(~/.my.cnf), if it exists, will be read, even if I(config_file) is not specified. The default config file, C(~/.my.cnf), if it exists, must contain a C([client]) section as a MySQL connector requirement. To prevent the default config file from being read, set I(config_file) to be an empty string.

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: The connection timeout when connecting to the MySQL server.

options.name: connection_name
options.description: Name of the primary connection. Supported from MariaDB 10.0.1. Mutually exclusive with I(channel). For more information see U(https://mariadb.com/kb/en/library/multi-source-replication/).

options.name: fail_on_error
options.description: Fails on error when calling mysql.

options.name: login_host
options.description: Host running the database. In some cases for local connections the I(login_unix_socket=/path/to/mysqld/socket), that is usually C(/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.sock), needs to be used instead of I(login_host=localhost).

options.name: login_password
options.description: The password used to authenticate with.

options.name: login_port
options.description: Port of the MySQL server. Requires I(login_host) be defined as other than localhost if login_port is used.

options.name: login_unix_socket
options.description: The path to a Unix domain socket for local connections. Use this parameter to avoid the C(Please explicitly state intended protocol) error.

options.name: login_user
options.description: The username used to authenticate with.

options.name: mode
options.description: Module operating mode. Could be C(changeprimary) (CHANGE MASTER TO) - also works for MySQL 8.0.23 and later since ansible.mysql 3.10.0, C(changereplication) (CHANGE REPLICATION SOURCE TO) - only supported in MySQL 8.0.23 and later, C(getprimary) (SHOW MASTER STATUS), C(getreplica) (SHOW REPLICA STATUS), C(startreplica) (START REPLICA), C(stopreplica) (STOP REPLICA), C(resetprimary) (RESET MASTER) - supported since ansible.mysql 0.1.0, C(resetreplica) (RESET REPLICA), C(resetreplicaall) (RESET RE

options.name: primary_auto_position
options.description: Whether the host uses GTID based replication or not. Same as the C(MASTER_AUTO_POSITION) mysql variable.

options.name: primary_connect_retry
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_CONNECT_RETRY) mysql variable.

options.name: primary_delay
options.description: Time lag behind the primary's state (in seconds). Same as the C(MASTER_DELAY) mysql variable. Available from MySQL 5.6. For more information see U(https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/replication-delayed.html).

options.name: primary_host
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_HOST) mysql variable.

options.name: primary_log_file
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_LOG_FILE) mysql variable.

options.name: primary_log_pos
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_LOG_POS) mysql variable.

options.name: primary_password
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_PASSWORD) mysql variable.

options.name: primary_port
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_PORT) mysql variable.

options.name: primary_ssl
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_SSL) mysql variable. When setting it to C(yes), the connection attempt only succeeds if an encrypted connection can be established. For details, refer to L(MySQL encrypted replication documentation,https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/replication-solutions-encrypted-connections.html). The default is C(false).

options.name: primary_ssl_ca
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_SSL_CA) mysql variable. For details, refer to L(MySQL encrypted replication documentation,https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/replication-solutions-encrypted-connections.html).

options.name: primary_ssl_capath
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_SSL_CAPATH) mysql variable. For details, refer to L(MySQL encrypted replication documentation,https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/replication-solutions-encrypted-connections.html).

options.name: primary_ssl_cert
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_SSL_CERT) mysql variable. For details, refer to L(MySQL encrypted replication documentation,https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/replication-solutions-encrypted-connections.html).

options.name: primary_ssl_cipher
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_SSL_CIPHER) mysql variable. Specifies a colon-separated list of one or more ciphers permitted by the replica for the replication connection. For details, refer to L(MySQL encrypted replication documentation,https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/replication-solutions-encrypted-connections.html).

options.name: primary_ssl_key
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_SSL_KEY) mysql variable. For details, refer to L(MySQL encrypted replication documentation,https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/replication-solutions-encrypted-connections.html).

options.name: primary_ssl_verify_server_cert
options.description: Same as C(MASTER_SSL_VERIFY_SERVER_CERT) MySQL/MariaDB variable. The module switch automatically to C(SOURCE_SSL_VERIFY_SERVER_CERT) for MySQL 8.0.23 and later. Prior to ansible.mysql 3.14.0 C(false) had no effect.

options.name: primary_use_gtid
options.description: Configures the replica to use the MariaDB Global Transaction ID. C(disabled) equals MASTER_USE_GTID=no command. To find information about available values see U(https://mariadb.com/kb/en/library/change-master-to/#master_use_gtid). Available since MariaDB 10.0.2.

options.name: primary_user
options.description: Same as the C(MASTER_USER) mysql variable.

options.name: relay_log_file
options.description: Same as mysql variable.

options.name: relay_log_pos
options.description: Same as mysql variable.
